g.text: Convolution integrates the overlap of a signal with a flipped, shifted response

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: y(t)=∫x(τ)h(t−τ)dτ. Flip h(τ) to h(−τ), then shift by t. Both pulses have unit amplitude and duration1 s; y rises from0 to1 s of overlap, then falls to0 at
t=2 s. Endpoint values do not change the integral.
